correctness.rationale: Petersen KG(5,2) 10 vertices, ordinary cut defined by complements of disconnected induced four-subgraphs, NOT total cut. Direct reconstruction checks all 210 possible 4-sets, 140 disconnected, 140 six-vertex facets, 766 faces including empty, f=(1,10,45,120,210,240,140). Reconstruct deterministic 369-pair matching, one 0-cell and 26 5-cells and all 3330 oriented covers over 765 nonempty faces acyclic. Hence integral wedge of 26 S5. Every element of S5 acts on the ten pairs; exact signed face Lefschetz gives per conjugacy class (26,6,-2,2,0,0,1). Inner products via permutation, 2-subset and exterior-square characters give multiplicities (1,2,1,2,0,0,0), so rational H5≅Sp(5)+2Sp(4,1)+Sp(3,2)+2Sp(3,1,1). Independent mod-two boundary ranks (9,36,84,126,114) consistent but not basis of integral wedge proof.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical highly symmetric girth-five graph and ordinary k-cut complexes form a natural hierarchy. Exact classification at k=4, including the 26-sphere integral homotopy type and an explicit reducible full S5 module, fills a motivated finite parameter case after the known k=2 and k=3 studies. Equivariant information is not a routine consequence of the Euler characteristic.
residual_risks: Scope is exactly as in the stated limitations; no unsupported downstream/general theorem claimed.

limitations: No equivariant wedge equivalence or classification of all cut parameters/Kneser graphs; ordinary Δ4 not total; exact finite computation on one ten-vertex object.
